text_en: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
text_cn: 基督耶稣的仆人保禄和弟茂德，致书给斐理伯的众位在基督耶稣内的圣徒、监督及执事：

text_en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安由天主我们的父和主耶稣基督赐与你们！

text_en: I thank my God every time I remember you,
text_cn: 我一想起你们，就感谢我的天主；

text_en: constantly praying with joy in every one of my prayers for all of you,
text_cn: 我每次祈祷，总怀着喜悦为你们众位祈祷，

text_en: because of your sharing in the gospel from the first day until now.
text_cn: 因为你们从最初的一天直到现在，就协助了宣传福音的工作；

text_en: I am confident of this, that the one who began a good work among you will bring it to completion by the day of Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 我深信，在你们内开始这美好工作的那位，必予以完成，直到耶稣基督的日子。

text_en: It is right for me to think this way about all of you, because you hold me in your heart, for all of you share in God’s grace with me, both in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel.
text_cn: 我这样想念你们众人，是理当的，因为我在心内常怀念你们，不论我带锁链，或辩护或确证福音时，你们常参与了我受的恩宠。

text_en: For God is my witness, how I long for all of you with the compassion of Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 天主为我作证：我是怎样以基督耶稣的情怀爱你们众人。

text_en: And this is my prayer, that your love may overflow more and more with knowledge and full insight
text_cn: 我所祈求的是：愿你们的爱德日渐增长，满渥真知识和各种识见，

text_en: to help you to determine what is best, so that in the day of Christ you may be pure and blameless,
text_cn: 使你们能辨别卓绝之事，为叫你们直到基督的日子，常是洁净无瑕的，

text_en: having produced the harvest of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ for the glory and praise of God.
text_cn: 赖耶稣基督满结义德的果实，为光荣赞美天主。

text_en: I want you to know, beloved, that what has happened to me has actually helped to spread the gospel,
text_cn: 弟兄们！我愿意告诉你们，我的环境对于福音的进展，反而更有了益处，

text_en: so that it has become known throughout the whole imperial guard and to everyone else that my imprisonment is for Christ;
text_cn: 以致御营全军和其余众人都明明知道，我带锁链是为基督的缘故；

text_en: and most of the brothers and sisters, having been made confident in the Lord by my imprisonment, dare to speak the word with greater boldness and without fear.
text_cn: 并且大多数的弟兄，因见我带锁链，就依靠主，更敢讲论天主的道理，一点也不害怕。

text_en: Some proclaim Christ from envy and rivalry, but others from goodwill.
text_cn: 有些人宣讲基督，固然是出于嫉妒和竞争，有些人却是出于善意；

text_en: These proclaim Christ out of love, knowing that I have been put here for the defense of the gospel;
text_cn: 这些出于爱的人，知道我是被立为护卫福音的；

text_en: the others proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely but intending to increase my suffering in my imprisonment.
text_cn: 那些出于私见宣传基督的人，目的不纯正，想要给我的锁链更增添烦恼。

text_en: What does it matter? Just this, that Christ is proclaimed in every way, whether out of false motives or true; and in that I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
text_cn: 那有什么妨碍呢？无论如何，或是假意，或是诚心，终究是宣传了基督。为此如今我喜欢，将来我仍然要喜欢，

text_en: for I know that through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ this will turn out for my deliverance.
text_cn: 因为我知道，赖你们的祈祷和耶稣基督的圣神的辅助，这事必有利于我的得救。

text_en: It is my eager expectation and hope that I will not be put to shame in any way, but that by my speaking with all boldness, Christ will be exalted now as always in my body, whether by life or by death.
text_cn: 按照我所热切期待希望的，我在任何事上必不会蒙羞，所以现在和从前一样，我反而放心大胆，我或生或死，总要叫基督在我身上受颂扬。

text_en: For to me, living is Christ and dying is gain.
text_cn: 因为在我看来，生活原是基督，死亡乃是利益。

text_en: If I am to live in the flesh, that means fruitful labor for me; and I do not know which I prefer.
text_cn: 但如果生活在肉身内，我还能获得工作的效果：我现在选择哪一样，我自己也不知道。

text_en: I am hard pressed between the two: my desire is to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better;
text_cn: 我正夹在两者之间：我渴望求解脱而与基督同在一起：这实在是再好没有了；

text_en: but to remain in the flesh is more necessary for you.
text_cn: 但存留在肉身内，对你们却十分重要。

text_en: Since I am convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with all of you for your progress and joy in faith,
text_cn: 我确信不疑：我知道我必要存留，且必要为你们众人存留于世，为使你们在信德上，得到进展和喜乐，

text_en: so that I may share abundantly in your boasting in Christ Jesus when I come to you again.
text_cn: 并使你们因着我再来到你们中，同我在基督耶稣内更加欢跃。

text_en: Only, live your life in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that, whether I come and see you or am absent and hear about you, I will know that you are standing firm in one spirit, striving side by side with one mind for the faith of the gospel,
text_cn: 你们生活度日只应合乎基督的福音，好叫我或来看望你们，或不在时，听到关于你们的事，而知道你们仍保持同一的精神，一心一意为福音的信仰共同奋斗，

text_en: and are in no way intimidated by your opponents. For them this is evidence of their destruction, but of your salvation. And this is God’s doing.
text_cn: 一点也不为敌人所吓住：这样证明了他们必将丧亡，你们必将得救，因为这是出于天主，

text_en: For he has graciously granted you the privilege not only of believing in Christ, but of suffering for him as well—
text_cn: 因为，为了基督的缘故，赐给你们的恩赐，不但是为相信他，而且也是为为他受苦：

text_en: since you are having the same struggle that you saw I had and now hear that I still have.
text_cn: 就是要遭受你们曾在我身上所见的，及如今由我所听到的同样的决斗。
